name: Gaming & Community

designIntent.primaryGoal: Help members find people, events, updates and shared activities quickly.
designIntent.visualThesis: Expressive community identity balanced with clear moderation, status and navigation.

visualDirection.density: medium-to-high in activity feeds and member lists
visualDirection.surfaces: separate social content, controls and moderation actions without excessive nesting
visualDirection.colorIntent: brand accent plus accessible status tokens; never rely on color alone for presence or rank
visualDirection.typography: distinct display voice with readable small-screen body and metadata
visualDirection.motion: feedback for reactions, live events and state transitions; no flashing or unavoidable loops

layout.pattern: community navigation + feed/events + member or detail sidebar
layout.spacing: compact lists with clear grouping and strong control hit areas
layout.responsive: prioritize feed and current event; secondary panels move into navigation

accessibility.keyboard: all community navigation and moderation actions must be reachable
accessibility.focus: modals and menus manage focus correctly
accessibility.reducedMotion: disable flashing, pulsing and non-essential animated backgrounds

antiPatterns: rank or role communicated only by color
notes: Make reporting, blocking and moderation paths discoverable and understandable.
